descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S18 Status sort after the server-side day roll and the 18 h note window; same order on a wrong-date device

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Hospital: sort by room, by name and by status each puts the list in the correct order. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 4; TFA-92581 AC 5)
  • U7 Nursing Home: sort by room (unit/room), by name and by status each puts the residents in the correct order. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 4; TFA-92581 AC 6)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Hospital: 'QA Hosp Aged-Note' post-rounded with a note generated 19 h ago (room 2); 'QA Hosp Aged-Pre' pre-rounded, pre-round processed on the previous server (UTC) calendar day, no encounter or note (room 4); 'QA Hosp Fresh-Pending' pending (room 3); 'QA Hosp Fresh-Pre' pre-rounded today (room 1). …

When Open each list (the lifecycle runs on route entry and every 10 min) and choose the status sort. Repeat on the wrong-date device. Note the local time at which a pre-rounded patient flips to Pending, against the physician's local midnight

Then Aged-Note and Aged-Pre both show Not Yet Prepped / Pending. They sort inside that group with Fresh-Pending, ties in room order (Aged-Note 2, Fresh-Pending 3, Aged-Pre 4), and Fresh-Pre stays Pre-Rounded after them. The wrong-date device shows identical labels and order

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.6 (note 18 h) and 3.8 (server clock; a wrong-date device shows the same state) applied to U2/U7. A tester compares labels and card order on the two devices. The roll time against local midnight is recorded for Q14, not judged. Device-clock effects are a known issue (TFA-92584): report a wrong-date difference as 'Fail (known: TFA-92584)'

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S18 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane newspec-c (newspec-c/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved) (TIME (back-dated seed: noteGeneratedAt -19 h, notesProcessedAt on the previous server day; the lifecycle runs on route entry)); secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev/newspec-c.
